primitives.meaning: a specific unmet requirement: an integration not connected, a required configuration absent, a verification incomplete, a required person not yet present, a mandatory setup step unfinished
entryFilters: a specific unmet requirement: an integration not connected, a required configuration absent, a verification incomplete, a required person not yet present, a mandatory setup step unfinished
no instance of this journey is already open for the the blocking requirement
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.does: Identify the exact requirement and what it is blocking, so everything downstream can name it rather than describe setup in general

primitives.asks: Does this requirement actually block activation?

branches.label: Genuinely blocking
branches.test: activation cannot occur while it is unmet

branches.label: Incomplete but not blocking
branches.test: the field or step is missing and value can still be produced without it

primitives.state: not a blocker; ordinary onboarding continues
primitives.reEntry: if the same requirement later becomes mandatory, it enters as a real blocker; presenting it as one now would teach people to ignore the ones that matter

primitives.asks: Can this account resolve the requirement directly?

branches.label: Yes, directly
branches.test: the account holds the access, the information and the permission needed

branches.label: No, it depends on someone else
branches.test: it needs another team, an internal process, a third party, or a person who has not joined yet

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it
the person is active in the product and the action is taken there

primitives.purpose: Give the one specific action that clears this requirement, named as the thing it is - never a general prompt to finish setup, which tells someone who is already blocked nothing they did not know
primitives.brief: Give the one specific action that clears this requirement, named as the thing it is - never a general prompt to finish setup, which tells someone who is already blocked nothing they did not know

mustNotClaim: that setup in general is unfinished

primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.does: Raise the requirement with whoever can actually resolve it, carrying what is blocked and why. Ownership of the resume stays here, so the account is not handed away and forgotten

cancelOn.meaning: the specific named requirement that blocked progress is recorded as satisfied

primitives.reads: the the blocking requirement re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

primitives.does: Stop every reminder about this requirement immediately, including any already queued - a nudge about something the person has just finished is the clearest possible signal that nothing was watching

primitives.asks: With this requirement met, is activation now reachable?

branches.label: Reachable
branches.test: no other mandatory requirement is outstanding

branches.label: Another requirement is blocking
branches.test: clearing this one revealed a second mandatory requirement

primitives.on: the blocker cleared and activation reachable again
carries: which requirement was resolved and how long it took
the setup state as it now stands, so onboarding resumes rather than restarts

primitives.state: resolved; a further requirement now blocks
primitives.reEntry: the next requirement opens its own instance, named on its own terms - stacking them into one message is how a specific blocker turns back into generic setup pressure

primitives.asks: What does this unresolved requirement warrant?

branches.label: Escalate to a person
branches.test: the requirement matters enough to the outcome that a human should now own it

branches.label: An alternate route exists
branches.test: value can be reached by a different path that does not need this requirement

branches.label: No route
branches.test: the requirement is mandatory and neither resolvable nor avoidable

primitives.on: a blocker outliving its resolution horizon
carries: the requirement, who was asked, and what has already been tried
what activation is waiting on, so the person picking it up starts informed
suppresses: automated reminders about this requirement while a person holds it

primitives.on: an alternate path to value that does not require the blocked thing
carries: the requirement that could not be met

primitives.reEntry: the requirement becoming satisfiable later re-opens this; nothing is repeatedly asked for in the meantime
